question: Can you provide the highest and lowest profits for Italian customers segmented into ten evenly divided tiers based on their December 2021 sales profits?
sql:
SELECT decile, MIN(total_profit) as lowest_profit, MAX(total_profit) as highest_profit, COUNT(*) as customer_count
FROM (
    SELECT c.cust_id, SUM(p.quantity_sold * (p.unit_price - p.unit_cost)) as total_profit, NTILE(10) OVER (ORDER BY total_profit) as decile
    FROM profits p 
    JOIN customers c ON p.cust_id = c.cust_id 
    JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id 
    WHERE co.country_name = 'Italy' 
      AND p.time_id >= '2021-12-01' AND p.time_id <= '2021-12-31'
    GROUP BY c.cust_id
)
GROUP BY decile
ORDER BY decile
